findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code execution via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-execution-setuptools
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  ) and
  not call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%/_vendor/%")
select call, "Use of " + call.getFunction().toString() + " may allow arbitrary code execution."
findings.hypothesis: Detecting unsafe use of eval/exec/compile functions in setuptools code that could lead to arbitrary code execution

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-setuptools
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  ) and
  not call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%/_vendor/%")
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization using " + call.getFunction().toString() + " that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization using pickle, marshal, or other unsafe methods that could execute arbitrary code
